QF.id: III-C Prevention of Money Laundering Act_17

question.text: Are intermediaries required to make nil reporting to FIU-IND if there are no suspicious transactions to report?

answer.text: Yes, nil reporting is required annually
No, no nil reporting needs to be made
Yes, nil reporting is mandatory every month
Yes, nil reporting is required quarterly

explanation.text: The Logic: No nil reporting needs to be made to FIU-IND where there are no cash, suspicious, or non-profit organization transactions to report (NISM-Series-III-C workbook, p.174). The Trap: Other regulatory regimes often require periodic nil returns, but the PMLA position on p.174 does not. Note: Read the no-nil-reporting rule directly from p.174 rather than from any general administrative reasoning.
